title: Lapseless
description: A nine-dollar neural patch that deletes sleep, so your third lost life can finally answer emails.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-smooth
lines.text: Why waste a third of your life unconscious? For nine dollars a month, the Lapseless patch deletes sleep forever. Your eyes never close again.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Lapseless permanently disables the blink reflex. <p:0> Eyelids sold separately. <p:0> Cancellation is structurally impossible. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
